searchText: <josephdelong> For some research I am doing for Eth2 I need to know the block witness size for stateless Eth1. Can someone help me out? Thanks <gichiba> Igor will be able to answer if he's got more up to date data but I happen to have this in my notes if you wanted some ballpark figures: <gichiba> https://medium.com/@mandrigin/semi-stateless-initial-sync-experiment-897cc9c330cb <gichiba> also this one, which might be more what you're looking for: https://medium.com/@mandrigin/stateless-ethereum-binary-tries-experiment-b2c035497768 Hey! I don't have any new data, and I didn't have plans to do more tests until our witness spec isn't done. Otherwise, I will measure something that will change relatively soon. But I doubt that the numbers will be that different until we add code merkelization btw, I added links to different articles regarded Stateless Ethereum experiments to the readme of the specs repo: https://github.com/ethereum/stateless-ethereum-specs/blob/master/README.md
